rationale: The proposed decline rests on a risk assessment computed from stale income (v1); a corrected income (v2) exists. The action is unsound, so hold and recompute before committing. Failures are measured both directions: a wrongful decline is held, not just a wrongful approve.
resume_condition: Recompute the risk assessment from income v2, then re-decide.
no_single_culprit_justification: Every step ran correctly on the data it had; the correction arrived legitimately. Only the composition — deciding on a risk assessment built from superseded income — is wrong.
note: Failures are measured both directions: here ground truth is ALLOW and a naive method would wrongly DENY.
